summary: Frontend-only verification of dragon name full-width-row restructure fix on Overview (DragonColumn.tsx) and Dragons list (dragons.tsx). Confirmed via live browser automation (mobile viewport 375x667) that name is now on its own full-width row above avatar/icons (Overview) and above avatar+meta row (Dragons list), giving full horizontal width (~327px on Overview, ~231px on Dragons list) instead of being squeezed next to avatar/icons. Tested with existing 'Sif - Demo Dragon' (fully visible, no truncation) and temporarily with a much longer name 'Extremely Long Bearded Dragon Test Name For Wrapping' on both screens: Dragons list wrapped to 3 lines fully readable with zero truncation (card auto-grows height); Overview wrapped to 2 lines and displayed the FULL string with no ellipsis (DragonColumn still has numberOfLines={2} but because the row is now full-width, the entire 54-char name fit within 2 lines without being cut off - verified via inner_text() exact match against expected string). Reverted dragon name back to 'Sif - Demo Dragon' successfully, no data pollution left. Regression checks: activity toggle (Active/Brumation) on Overview works correctly (toast shown, icon highlight swaps, task list updates to reflect brumation-hidden feeding tasks); edit/delete icon buttons on Dragons list card remain visible and functional; Weight button present. Smoke tested Tasks, Schedules, Admin tabs - all load without errors, Admin Help/FAQ section intact.
critical_code_review_comments: DragonColumn.tsx: name Text is now first full-width child of column with numberOfLines={2} - this is technically still a hard cap of 2 lines, but since the row now has full column width, real-world long names (tested up to 54 chars) fit within 2 lines without truncation. An extremely long name (>60-70 chars) could still theoretically get ellipsis-truncated at 2 lines; consider removing numberOfLines cap or bumping to 3 for extra safety margin, though not required based on current test data.

dragons.tsx: cardNameRow correctly puts name in its own row with edit/delete icons; name Text has flexWrap:'wrap' and no numberOfLines restriction, so it fully wraps to as many lines as needed (verified 3 lines for the long test name) - most robust of the two fixes.
Both files are clean, isolated changes, no regressions found in adjacent card elements (avatar, age badge, meta text, weight button, activity toggle).
seed_data_creation: None. Temporarily renamed 'Sif - Demo Dragon' to a long test string via edit form to verify full-width name wrapping on both Overview and Dragons list screens, then reverted to original name - no data pollution left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full-width name row restructure fully verified working on both Overview and Dragons list for long dragon names. No truncation observed with names up to 54 characters. Minor suggestion (not a bug): DragonColumn.tsx still caps at numberOfLines={2} which could theoretically truncate names longer than what was tested (>60-70 chars) - not required to fix unless user reports it again.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found in this session, fix verified working as intended for both screens.
